{{Quote|Welcome traveler. I am a buyer of goods that most would deem as junk.|Kinuagha|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Kinuagha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] and member of the [[Kerritamba Village]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She and her people were enemies of the [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts]] of [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kinuagha was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
